༄༅/ /byang gter lcags sdong ma tshar lugs kyi dbang chog 'chi med grub pa'i sa bon bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma ā yur+dzñā na ma/byang gter lcags sdo

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /byang gter lcags sdong ma tshar lugs kyi dbang chog 'chi med grub pa'i sa bon bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pad+ma ā yur+dzñā na ma/ byang gter lcags sdong ma lha gcig gi dbang ma gtogs cher ma bshad kyang / tshe dbang yongs rdzogs dang khog bsgrigs pa'i gter ston dngos kyi phyag len bkra bzang pa chos skyong bsod nams kyi gsung rgyun bzhin/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho yab sras gnyis ka la rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis lan mang du gsan pa'i gsung rgyun kho na bzhin/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi gter gzhung dngos la cho ga'i sgrig rim ka brda can dang / der ma 'thus pa'i gsung rgyun phyag len rnams mchan du gnang ba de nyid rtogs sla zhing yi ge nyung ba'i phyir 'dir nag 'gros su bkod na/ 'chi med grub pa'i sa bon lcags sdong ma'i dbang bskur tshul la/ grub na yar ngo'i tshes grangs gza' skar bzang po dang / de min skabs su gang babs bzhag la gnas gtsang mar stegs rten khebs sogs kyi khebs can 'bru bkram pa la rdul tshon nam/ ras gzhi sogs la bris pa'i pad+ma 'dab brgyad sngon po'i steng / mañdzu'i khar bum pa gas chag med pa'i nang g.yas su gtsang chen nam/ rgyun babs kyi chu gtsang mas sum gnyis bkang bar bum rdzas nyer lnga bdud rtsi ril bu chos sman sogs btab/ dar ras kha dog gang rung bag ral tshig skyon med pas mgul bcings pa'i khar gzhi zan gtsang ma'am/ thud gtsang ma la rten 'brel gyi rdzas brag zhun gyi gras lcags zhun cong zhi'i gras cung zhi dmar po/ bu dkar grog mo sbrang mar ser kyi sbrang rtsi/ dbyar gong gi 'bri mar te dwangs ma lnga dang / shugs pa'i 'bru ba lu dkar po'i me tog lug 'tshe/ mkhan pa dkar po ste rtsi bzhi rnams bsres na legs te/ 'di rnams sman gzhung las lus dang tshe'i gsos su gsungs pas rtsi bzhi dwangs ma lnga'i sman dmar sgrub pa can yod tshe de bsres pas go chod cing /

byin rlabs che ba dang / gzhan yang gong du bshad pa'i bdud rtsi'i ril chos sogs byin rten yid ches bsres pa las grub pa'i tshe bum dam gzugs zlum po rtsi dmar rtse rgyan can bzhag de'i g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du tshe chang / mdun du zlum gtor gnyis/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod phreng tshar slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril 'thor nas tshe mda' tshe g.yu me long can dar tshon sna lnga'am/ dmar pos brgyan pa/ slob ma la dgos pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bru bcas chab bum rnams bshams so/ /cho ga'i rim pa nas mchod pa rnams la dmigs nas/ g.yas rdo rje thugs ka dang / g.yon dril bu rgyun chags su bkrol la/ oṃ ā ha ra aḥha ra sarba bid+yā ra/ pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shap+ta'i bar lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma tshe dpag med bzhugs pa la skyabs su 'gro zhing sems bskyed pa'i bsam pas/ bdag dang khams gsum sems can rnams/ /log pa'i lam nas log nas kyang / /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ /nyon mongs dbang gyur sdug bsngal las/ /thar bar bya phyir sems bskyed do/ /lan gsum/ dang po stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad gdan/ /de steng bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /sku mdog dmar po skyil krung bzhugs/ /sprul pa'i cha byad dar gos mnabs/ /phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'dzin/ /sku che yan lag rags pa'i tshad/ /phrag pa g.yas g.yon nyi zla 'char/ /dwangs ma 'od lnga'i rgyab yol can/ khog pa'i nang nas bag chags kyi/ /snyigs ma gdos bcas thams cad sbyangs/ /'chi med tshe yi bdud rtsis gang / /zla gam dmar po'i mdog ltar gsal/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas gsang gnas bar/ /lcags kyi srog rtsa smyug sdong tsam/ /ka ba btsugs pa lta bur bsam/ /nang na stong pa'i 'od gsal mdangs/ /kha dog lngar gsal 'od zer 'bar/ /srog rtsa'i phyi nang sngags kyi 'bru/

/dung mdog zil chags lta bur bsam/ /bde ba can nas ye shes sems/ /rang 'dra spyan drangs mkha' la zhugs/ /bum pa'i nang nas tshe chu lud/ /bdag gi tshangs bug nang du bsam/ /dbang bskur lha dang gnyis med gyur/ /lha dang srog rtsa bdud rtsi las/ /'od 'phros gsal 'tsher mdangs dang ldan/ /tho rangs sngags 'di brgya rtsa bzlas/ /zhes brjod la phreng ba bzung ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ na mo bha ga wa te a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dzñā na su bi ni sh+tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye/ mahā puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ya dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shud+dha dharmā te ga ga na sa mud+ga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe ma hā na ya pa ri wā re swā hā/ ṇi bh+rūṃ badz+ra ā yur+dzñā na sid+dhi āḥbh+rūṃ/ zhes bzlas pa 'phreng skor sogs kyi ci rigs kyi rjes su/ ting 'dzin sngags kyi 'od zer ni/ /lcags kyu lta bus snod bcud gang / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /thugs rje byin rlabs dngos grub 'dus/ /phyogs skyong mkha' 'gro sde brgyad kyi/ /rdzu 'phrul tshe bkrag gzi mdangs phrogs/ /ri rab gling bzhi gling phran dang / /gser gyi ri bdun rol mtsho dang / /rtsi shing nags tshal rat+na'i tshogs/ /'byung ba lnga yi dwangs ma 'dus/ /lha klu mi yi dbang thang dang / /bsod nams mi yi dngos grub 'dus/ /bdud rtsi 'od zer char ltar babs/ /thams cad ma lus bdag la thim/ /bdag lus bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ /stong gsal 'od kyi phung por gyur/ /zhes brjod/ de nas mdun gyi tshe bum/ bum pa tshe ril tshe chang thams cad shu n+ya tas sbyangs/ dang por stong pa'i nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ de steng tshe rdzas 'od dpag med zhes bsgyur/ bzlas pa mang du byas mthar/ ting 'dzin sngags kyi 'od zer ni/ /zhes sogs gong bzhin la/

thams cad tshe rdzas lha la thim/ /de rnams sku lus bdud rtsis gang / /stong gsal 'od kyi sku ru gyur/ /zhes dang / rdo rje dang bcas pas tshe mda' g.yab dril bu bsil/ hūm̐ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med/ /'byung ba lnga la dbang bsgyur lha mo'i tshogs/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi tshe dang g.yang spel cig /steng 'og phyogs bcu snod kyi 'jig rten la/ /bros dang 'khyams dang yar ba'i tshe khug cig /stong phrag brgyad cu bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kyis/ /brkus dang 'phrog dang gzhom pa'i tshe khug cig 'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i las sbyor gyis/ /nyams dang zad dang 'chor ba'i tshe gsos shig /yis kyis dngangs dang hod kyis brgyal ba dang / /'ur gyis 'drog pa'i tshe dang g.yang gsos shig /tshe khug g.yang skyobs bdag la dngos grub stsol/ /'byung ba 'od lnga 'bar ba'i tshe bcud stims/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /zhes brjod do/ /mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri mi ta a yur+dzñā na sa pa ri wā rā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ zhes sogs 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par byas la rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bstod pas bstod/ bsdu na 'dis chog spro na/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad dang sna bdun sna lnga spyi 'gros bzhin la/ mos blos tshe dpag med la bdag 'bul na/ zhes tshig bsgyur la/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs bstod pa gang shes kyis bstod/ gtor ma gnyis la dmigs nas/ hūm̐ skye shi gnyis spangs bde ba chen po'i sku/ /mi 'gyur tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /'byung ba lnga 'dus gsal 'tsher brtan pa'i sku/ /thun mong tshe yi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /lan gsum/ bum pa dang gtor ma rang gi spyi bor lhan cig tu bzhag la/ hūm̐ bcom ldan mgon po sogs gong gi tshe 'gugs dang tshe gzungs brjod/ mgrin pa dang / snying khar reg la tshe gzungs tshar re brjod mthar/

bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med/ /'khor los bsgyur nas bdag gi snying khar bzhugs/ /'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par shog /ces bum chu btung dril bu bsil zhing me tog gtor/ bdag gi tshe mi zhig pa'i rdo rje ltar gyur cig mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig skye med kyi ye shes su gyur cig tshe dbang du gyur cig dbang dngos grub tu gyur cig bdud las rgyal bar gyur cig skye shi med pa rdo rje'i lus thob par gyur cig su pra tiṣ+ṭha/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i dang / lo brgya thub pa sogs kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod kha dang gtor ma gsos/ slar yang mdun bskyed mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab ste/ bzlas pa ci rigs/ mchod bstod gtor ma'i bar bya'o/ /slob ma khrus byas phyag dang yon phul gral la 'khod nas me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang / slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsal btab la/ ༈ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal ma lus pa la dgongs nas chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa thams cad bsdu na theg pa che chung gnyis su gsungs pa las theg pa chen po yin zhing / theg pa chen po 'di nyid chen po bdun gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa yin te/ rje btsun byams pa mgon pos mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa che ba nyid dang ni/ /de bzhin sgrub pa gnyis dag dang / /ye shes dngos grub rtsom pa dang / /thabs la mkhas par gyur pa dang / /yang dag sgrub pa chen po dang / /sangs rgyas 'phrin las chen po ste/ /chen po 'di dag ldan pa'i phyir/ /theg chen 'di ni nges par brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ chen po bdun gyi sgo nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i theg pa chen po la yang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang /

'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gnyis su yod pa las sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la snga 'gyur rnying ma dang / phyi 'gyur gsar ma'i lugs gnyis su yod pa las snga 'gyur rnying ma'i lugs yin zhing / de la yang lugs srol mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i nang nas/ 'dir rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dam pa slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas 'gro ba'i don du sin+dhu rgya mtsho'i gling du me tog pad+ma'i sdong po las sprul pa'i sku'i snang brnyan shar ba nas bzung ste gang la gang 'dul gyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa ji snyed bstan pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mnga' ba las 'dir skabs su babs pa ni o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba sku la skye 'chi bgres rgud 'das grong mi mnga' ba 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i tshul ni/ brag phug mā ra ti ka zhes pa zla gam gyi dbyibs su yod pa/ de'i logs thams cad tsan+dan gyi nags tshal mthug por skyes pa/ dus gsum du me tog gi char chen po 'bebs bzhin pa/ 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas kyi mchog de nyid du za hor gyi rgyal rigs las byung ba'i lha lcam man+dha ra ba nyid sgrub rten las kyi phyag rgya mdzad/ 'chi med tshe yi sgrub la rtse gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad pa'i tshe/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa zhi khro rab 'byams kyi rang zhal sgrib med mngon sum du gzigs te yab yum gnyis ka 'chi med gzhom zhig dang bral ba'i sra brtan rdo rje'i skur gyur te/ yo ga tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes par mdzad pa yang ma hā gu ru nyid kyi gsung gi sprul pa'i sku ri khrod pa bzang po grags pas gter nas spyan drangs par mdzad pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs las/ brag phug mā ra ti ka'i ke'u tshang du: /'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i tshe: /mgon po tshe dpag med kyis byin gyis brlabs:

/skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i lus su gyur: /zhes gsungs pa dang / thugs gter 'khor 'das rang grol las/ /mā ra ti ka'i brag phug tu: /'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin bsgrubs: /tshe dpag med kyis byin gyis brlabs: /skye 'chi med pa'i rdo rje grub: /ces gsungs pa ltar tshe sgrub lcags kyi sdong po 'di nyid la brten nas skye shi med pa rdo rje'i sku thob pa yin zhing / de nyid phyi rabs sems can gyi don brag ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i skad par sba bar mdzad pa de nyid o rgyan nyid du sprul pa rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis zang zang lha brag gi nub zangs mdzod dmar po nas bla ma tshe dpag tu med pa'i skor dang / dpal rta mgrin gyi sgrub skor rnams byung ba las/ bla ma tshe dpag med kyi skor yin/ 'di nyid rang gi gter yig nang ltar las/ snga dro tho rangs dang po la: ting 'dzin gsal bas brgya rtsa bzlas: tshe zad mtha' la thug pa yang : 'di sgrub lo brgya 'tsho bar nges: zhes gsungs pa ltar: byin rlabs can gyi tshe dbang 'bul bar byed pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba ni gter gzhung las/ yar ngo'i dus su gza' skar bzang po la: sa gtsang bkra shis dben pa'i gnas btsal te: 'bru spos sman dang rat+na snying po lnga: rgyun chad med pa'i chu yis bum pa bkang : gtsang ma'i gos dkris dpag bsam sdong pos brgyan: zhes gsungs pa ltar tshe'i sgrub rten ma nyams pa dbang gi yo byad 'os pa rnams phyag len bzhin legs par bsam ste/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul yang slob dpon gyi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa/ mdun gyi tshe bum/ bum pa/ tshe ril/ tshe chang rnams lhar bskyed de bzlas pa bya ba/ 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud bsdu ba/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba/ rang nyid kyis bdag 'jug len pa dang slar yang mdun bskyed gsal 'debs kyis bzlas pa mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams da gin nas kyi gnas skabs su legs par grub zin pa de yin/

da khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas thog mar bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag med gnyis su med pa la tshe dbang zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ snying ga me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ skye 'chi gnyis spangs tshe gsal btab lan gsum/ rgyud sdom ldan du bya ba'i phyir/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed tshe dpag med la tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha klu drang srong mthu bo che bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa bsrung zhing gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag dang khams gsum sems can lan gsum/ dngos gzhi byin rlabs kyi gzhi sprul pa la/ slob dpon la mos gus byas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma 'bum dus gcig tu shar ba lta bu 'phros lus la phog tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dus min 'chi ba rnam smin sha khrag phung po sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de nyid slob dpon gyis oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs pas/ 'od gsal stong nyid nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong nyid de'i ngang las khyed rang rnams gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs pad+ma dbang gi gzhal yas mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad pa la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya yongs su gang ba re re bzhin/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sems rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rnams re re bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba lta bu rab tu dwangs shing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum dang ldan pa/ sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs can/ sku che la yan lag rags pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon du nyi ma dang zla ba shar bas dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad sel bar byed pa/ dwangs ma 'od lnga'i rgyab yol can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de'i phyi rol pad+ma 'dab brgyad la/ shar du badz+ra tshe dpag med/ lhor rin chen tshe dpag med/ nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang du karma tshe dpag med rnams longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs can/ phyag mnyam bzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor sangs rgyas spyan ma/ lho nub tu mā ma ki nub byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du dam tshig sgrol ma thams cad kyang g.yas pas tshe'i mda' 'dzin cing / g.yon pas bum pa 'dzin pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi pad 'dab dkar po nyis brgya la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas dkar po nyis brgya/ de'i phyi rol gyi pad 'dab sngon po nyis brgya la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas sngon po nyis brgya/ de'i phyi rol gyi pad 'dab ser po nyis brgya la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas ser po nyis brgya/ de'i phyi rol gyi pad 'dab dmar po nyis brgya la skal bzang gi sangs rgyas dmar po nyis brgya/ de'i phyi rol gyi pad 'dab ljang gu nyis brgya la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas ljang gu nyis brgya/ gang la gang len pa'i tshul ni/ dbang rdzas rnams de dang mthun pa'i pad+ma dbang gi gzhal yas mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du rin po che zur brgyad pa'i dbus su/ lcags kyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i gdan dkar bsil nya yongs su gang ba'i steng du bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa chos sku snang ba mtha' yas phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na lhung bzed 'dzin pa/

de'i dbu gtsug tu chos sku kun tu bzang po phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng na gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa rin po che zur brgyad pa/ shar du pad+ma 'byung gnas/ lhor blo ldan mchog sred/ nub tu nyi ma 'od zer/ byang du seṅge sgra sgrog shar lhor pad+ma sam+bha wa/ lho nub tu pad+ma rgyal po/ nub byang du shākya seng ge byang shar du rdo rje gro lod/ shar sgor lcags kyu ma/ lho sgor zhags pa ma/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma/ byang sgor dril bu ma thams cad kyang g.yas pas tshe'i mda' dar 'dzin cing / g.yon 'chi med tshe'i gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa la/ slob dpon gyi lag tu tshe'i mda' dar g.yob bzhin pas/ tshe'i dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas/ /ye shes ye shes 'byung gnas che/ /kun tu bzang po'i dus la babs/ /'dir 'tshogs skal ldan bu rnams la/ /'chi med tshe dbang bskur du gsol/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ /'od dpag med pa'i dus la babs/ /pad+ma dbang gi gzhal yas su/ /'chi med dbang po lha yi lha/ /tshe dpag med pa'i༞ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du/ /dpal ldan sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas༞ bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /gsum rig gtsang ma dag pa ste/ /pad+ma sam+bha'i༞ po ta la yi gnas mchog tu/ /mkhas pa sgyu 'phrul chen po 'chang / /blo ldan mchog sred༞ dga' ba tshal gyi dur khrod du/ /'khor los bsgyur ba stobs po che/ /pad+ma rgyal po'i༞ so sa gling gi dur khrod na/ /nyi ma 'char ka'i dkyil ltar mdzes/ /nyi ma 'od zer༞ za hor rgyal po'i yul dbus su/ /thub pa chen po thub chen ldan/ /shākya seng ge༞ ma ga dha yi grong khyer du/ /bdag med seṅge'i sgra dang ldan/ /seṅge sgra sgrog༞ stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub tu/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/

/rdo rje gro lod༞ rang bzhin rnam dag gzhal yas nas/ /dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa ste/ /tshe'i lha tshogs༞ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sgo bzhi ru/ /rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa che/ /sgo ba bzhi yi༞ bka' dang dam tshig gzhal yas su/ /shugs chen mgyogs pa chen po ste/ /pho nya rnams kyi༞ 'dir tshogs skal ldan bu rnams la/ /'chi med tshe dbang bskur du gsol/ /zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ tshe'i lha tshogs rnams kyi phyag tu zla ba ltar dkar ba'i bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis yongs su gang ba cung zad yo ba dang bcas 'dzin bzhin pas dbang bskur bas lus kyi nang thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag tshe srog nyams pa sor chud/ 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med/ /zhes gzungs dang bcas spyi bo dang / mgrin pa/ snying du bzung nas bum chu byin te/ tshigs bcad bdag 'jug bzhin/ tshe ril dang tshe chang tshe dpag med du bskyed pa 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam par 'od du zhu ba/ khyed rang rnams la byin pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa thams cad dag 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sogs kyis gzungs dang bcas byin nas/ de dag gis tshe bsring ba'am spel ba yin la/ de nyid mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir sba dgos pas/ khyed rang rnams tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i lus dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngo skya sba lcag 'bring po tsam yar sna spyi gtsug mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa/ dwangs gsal rtog med 'od kyi rang bzhin drang thal le ba nu ma gnyis kyi bar thad kyi rtsa dbu ma'i nang du snying pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ha lo'i me tog kha phye ba lta bu'i nang du/

zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ sems rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo hrī dmar po ring cha tsheg drag bcas pa'i g.yas su tshe'i rang bzhin yi ge āḥdakar po/ g.yon du srog gi rang bzhin yi ge hrīḥljang khu gsal btab/ slob dpon la mos gus byas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog tshe chu dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du zhu ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying kha'i ye shes gsum po la thim/ ye shes gsum las kyang tshe chu babs/ lus thams cad gang / bgres rgud gzhom zhig thams cad dang bral ba dang / snang stong rdo rje lta bu'i lus su gyur par bsam/ slar ye shes gsum la sems gtad pas/ snying ha lo'i me tog kha zum pa lta bu'i spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab/ ye shes gsum bum nang mar me gsal ba lta bur sems gtad de/ mnyam par bzhag pas/ lus kyang mi chod mi gzhig pa/ /stong pa'i go cha bla na med/ /chos kyi dbyings su tshe sbas pas/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na/ /phyi rol gdon la smos ci dgos/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ me tog 'thor zhing dril bu bsil nas/ bdag gi rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams tshe mi gzhig pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig sogs bdag 'jug bzhin/ rjes su dam tshig bsdu ba sogs spyi dang 'dra/ rjes chog kha gso/ mchod bstod/ yig brgya bzod gsol sogs bya/ ye shes pa med pa'i dam tshig rnams slob ma la bstims pas gshegs bsdu sogs mi dgos kyang sgo ba tshig tsam du yi dam rnams rang la bsdu ba yang mdzad/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o/ /ces byang gter lcags sdong ma'i dbang 'di yang drin can rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs drung du lan grangs du ma'i bar du thob pa bzhin la sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/
